speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe the specific nature of your gait and limb ataxia; do you experience staggering, draping, or a wide-based stance? Additionally, can you tell me about any associated symptoms like nystagmus, vertigo, or double vision?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. To better localize the lesion, have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your limbs? Also, do you experience any difficulty swallowing or slurred speech?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

Please confirm if you have noticed any new visual disturbances, such as blind spots or loss of vision, and whether you have experienced any cognitive changes or personality shifts recently.
